subject: Weekend SLA carveout request for ISO audit — P1/P2 response commitments
messages:
From: Jessica Dawson <jessica.dawson@isoaudit.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: iso-ops@isoaudit.com
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Temporary weekend SLA adjustment for ISO audit (Aug 27-29)

Hi Soojin,

We're finalizing the schedule for our ISO 27001 external audit the weekend of Aug 27-29. The auditors will run hands-on tests and may need rapid-response assistance for a handful of live verification steps that touch your hosted inference endpoints.

Specifically, we need confirmation that Redwood can:
- Provide enhanced P1 response (acknowledge + mitigation start) within 30 minutes during the audit window (overnight UTC windows included)
- Provide P2 response within 2 hours
- Provide a named escalation path (on-call -> SRE lead -> Ops Director) with reachable phone numbers

We understand this is an exception; IsoAudit is prepared to sign an amendment and cover a temporary weekend on-call fee. Can you confirm feasibility and next steps by EOD Friday (Aug 20)? We also need a runbook or contact card to hand the auditors.

Thanks — we want to minimize disruption but need the guarantees for evidence.

Best,
Jessica Dawson
Lead Auditor, IsoAudit Solutions
[Attachment: audit-schedule-isoaudit.pdf (PDF, 24KB)]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Jessica Dawson <jessica.dawson@isoaudit.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Temporary weekend SLA adjustment for ISO audit (Aug 27-29)

Thanks Jessica — looping in our on-call/ops and contracts leads to assess. High level: we are usually covered by our standard P1/P2 windows, but this request asks for a guaranteed, shorter P1 ack window overnight and a formal escalation chain.

Karthik / Ops: can you confirm whether we can commit to 30m P1 ack and 2h P2 for a three-day window? If not exactly, what mitigations (engineer shadowing, hot seat) would let us meet the auditors' expectation? Please include any runbook stub or contact card we can send them.

Ben / Sales: if this requires a fee or amendment, can you draft a quick MAA (mutual action agreement) that covers Aug 27-29 and the proposed on-call flat rate?

Laura / Legal: will a short amendment suffice, or do we need a temporary SLA addendum with sign-off?

Proposed items I want before Friday EOD to confirm to IsoAudit:
- Feasibility statement from Ops (>= or < 30m P1)
- Draft amendment or pricing note
- Runbook/contact card PDF for auditors

Appreciate quick replies — auditors need confirmation to keep the date.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Strategic Programs Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: audit-questionnaire.pdf (PDF, 12KB)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2027 14:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Temporary weekend SLA adjustment for ISO audit (Aug 27-29)

Quick feasibility / ops note — we can support this with a controlled exception and a short runbook plus a staffed hot-seat model. Summary: 

- Commitment: We can commit to P1 acknowledgment within 30 minutes and P2 within 2 hours for the specified audit windows if the customer accepts a temporary operational carveout. This requires:
  * A named weekend hot-seat engineer per 4-hour block (we'll rotate)
  * SRE lead on-call standby for escalation (phone + Slack)
  * A short runbook (see stub attached) that auditors will use to route requests

- Risks/Notes:
  * This reduces our normal burst capacity for the weekend by reserving a hot-seat — minor cost impact to other customers, but acceptable for a short exception.
  * We need an explicit amendment that limits the exception to Aug 27-29, lists exact response windows, and states rollback conditions.

- Escalation chain (proposed):
  1) Hot-seat engineer (initial ack within 30m) — +1-415-555-0142
  2) SRE Lead (Karthik) — +1-415-555-0189
  3) Ops Director (Laura) — +1-415-555-0103

I've attached a one-page runbook stub: what to check, scope of audit interactions (endpoints allowed), and sample responses for auditors. If Legal signs off, Ops is ready to staff.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Site Reliability, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: runbook-isoaudit-weekend.pdf (PDF, 48KB)]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2027 15:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Temporary weekend SLA adjustment for ISO audit (Aug 27-29)

Thanks team — from an account perspective IsoAudit is a strategic customer and willing to cover reasonable costs. Proposal from Sales:

- One-time weekend amendment fee: $5,000 (flat) to cover hot-seat staffing and priority paging 
- Draft a simple amendment (term: Aug 27 00:00 UTC -- Aug 29 23:59 UTC) that includes the P1/P2 windows and the three-step escalation chain 
- Offer a short credit if we fail to meet the P1 ack commitment (e.g., prorated credit for any missed P1 acks) — attach SLA credit language from our standard docs

If Legal approves the language we can send the amendment via DocuSign and sign by Aug 21 to lock staffing. I'll prepare the price note and draft.

— Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Jessica Dawson <jessica.dawson@isoaudit.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Temporary weekend SLA adjustment for ISO audit (Aug 27-29)

Hi Jessica — thanks for the patience while we scoped this. Short answer: we can meet your request pending a signed short-form amendment and the agreed fee. Next steps and items enclosed below.

What Redwood will provide (Aug 27 00:00 UTC — Aug 29 23:59 UTC):
- P1 acknowledgment within 30 minutes; P2 response within 2 hours for tickets raised during the audit windows
- Named hot-seat engineer(s) staffed in 4-hour rotations
- Escalation chain: Hot-seat -> SRE Lead (Karthik) -> Ops Director (Laura) with phone reachability
- One-page runbook and contact card for auditors 

What we need from IsoAudit by Aug 21 EOD:
1) Signed amendment (DocuSign link below) — covers dates, response windows, and credit terms
2) Point of contact(s) who will raise tickets and phone number(s) for live escalation

Links and attachments: 
- Amendment (DocuSign): https://docusign.com/sign/abc123-isoaudit
- Draft amendment (attached): draft-amendment-isoaudit.docx
- Runbook (attached): runbook-isoaudit-weekend.pdf
- Internal ticket: JIRA-OPS-4921

If you confirm by Aug 21 we'll schedule the hot-seat rota and publish the runbook to the auditor contact list. If anything in the runbook scope is too restrictive, let us know and we'll update.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Strategic Programs Manager
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1-415-555-0110
[Attachments: draft-amendment-isoaudit.docx, runbook-isoaudit-weekend.pdf]
